              "8/8 criteria pass with reasons; limitations retained (fixture provenance, no renderer, family/style deferred). "
              "State revision 15; task completed at revisions 16-17.")},
    {"path": f"{R3}/specialist-result.json",
     "note": f"PIXL specialist result for import/inspection/review/completion (status delivered for that bounded scope). sha256 {sha(f'{R3}/specialist-result.json')}."},
    {"path": f"{CL}/independent-inspection.json",
     "note": f"Caller's independent pixel dump, derived 1x/3x/12x and grayscale views and per-criterion observations, made before reading the specialist review; consistent with all eight passes. sha256 {sha(f'{CL}/independent-inspection.json')}."},
    {"path": f"{CL}/integration-check-output.json",
     "note": (f"node verify-integration.mjs assets/ready-confirmed.png output (exit 0): statusCell and compactStatus both map "
              f"succeeded -> Ready -> assets/ready-confirmed.png frames 1; PNG header 16x16 equals display.cell; filter nearest; "
              f"file sha256 {CAND}. Module-level consumer check only, no renderer. sha256 {sha(f'{CL}/integration-check-output.json')}.")},
    {"path": STATE,
     "note": ("PX2 store after delivery stage: revision 17, hash fc5455196672aca53193d60b302a599afb49af2aab5b7fdd6a3f57a1ab3e935d; "
              "task r.028f320bf7292612.task done with nominated candidate r.028f320bf7292612.candidate.ready; job succeeded/imported; "
              "earlier tasks and jobs retained.")},
])
after = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
# Guard: only the queue.ready row changed, and only the allowed fields.
b = json.loads(before)
for a_old, a_new in zip(b["assets"], after["assets"]):
    if a_old["id"] != "queue.ready":
        assert a_old == a_new, a_old["id"]
    else:

for k in b:

print(out, hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest())

project.name: Queue status UI
project.brief: Allocate coherent pixel-art Working, Ready, Retry and Paused status assets for shared 16x16 queue cells while preserving the existing Start vector. Review a representative sample before family expansion; this allocation performs no asset generation.

included: Read BRIEF.md and SOURCE-MAP.md in full; re-read the changed brief, queue-state and queue-view source for this refresh.
Resolve the local ./queue type import and trace started/ok/error/pause through stateAfter to running/succeeded/failed/paused visual descriptors.
Trace both statusCell and compactStatus to the same statusVisuals map; allocate one shared asset per status rather than duplicate assets per consumer.
Inspect the only checked-in art, assets/start.svg, at source level for shape, dimensions and accent; verify the four current PNG destinations are absent.
Reconcile the Retry destination move to assets/error-retry.png while preserving its queue.retry ID and unchanged failure/retry purpose.
Capture unchanged display.cell, scale, nearest filtering, frameMs and dark-panel color from the supplied view descriptor.

Refresh for the Ready update: re-read BRIEF.md (aebe0094...) line 9 and src/queue-view.ts (4d6ee92e...) in full. succeeded now maps to assets/ready-confirmed.png (moved destination, same Ready role and queue.ready ID); Start (assets/start.svg), Working (assets/working.png, 4 frames), Paused (assets/paused.png) and Retry (assets/error-retry.png) rows, display descriptor and earlier brief paragraphs are unchanged. The Ready check mark with asymmetrical arms is now an owner requirement (BRIEF.md line 9) replacing the former sample_motif proposal.
excluded: Server-registry account badges returned by accountBadge are explicitly outside this local request; do not allocate replacement badge art.
No images are allocated for stateAfter or other functions without a visual role; the queue transitions determine status meaning only.
No new Start control, panel background, font, text label, host configuration, generated art or provider operation is assigned.
unresolved: No executable UI entry point, renderer, importer, package manifest or runtime capture was supplied. Descriptor inspection does not verify rendered behavior, frame cropping, alpha compositing or integration.
No approved style reference exists. Ready remains the proposed representative sample; Working, Retry and Paused depend on its review before family expansion.
The account badge registry is populated remotely and is not enumerable from this checkout; badges remain excluded.
The supplied SVG was inspected as source only. No artwork was generated, rendered, or visually accepted during allocation or refresh.

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
requirements.reason: Measured: PNG IHDR 16x16, 8-bit RGBA, single frame (frame_count 1, n_frames 1), no horizontal strip or extra canvas (pixl_asset_check width/height 16 pass; pixel-dump size [16,16]).

requirements.name: transparent-background
requirements.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
requirements.reason: Measured: alpha histogram {0: 227, 255: 29}; every pixel outside the single 29-pixel mark component has alpha 0; all four edge rows/columns fully transparent; no matte, box or fringe (fractional_alpha_pixels 0, opaque_components 1). Checkerboard views 3 and 4 confirm visually.

requirements.name: check-mark-asymmetrical-arms
requirements.check: The image visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms: the mark is not mirror-symmetric about its vertex. Asymmetry may come, for example, from clearly unequal arm lengths or from clearly different arm angles/directions; unequal length is one example, not the required condition. The mark conveys successful completion. Either arm may be the longer one, and stroke weight, colour treatment and construction are not restricted by this criterion.
requirements.reason: Viewed in views 1 and 2 on #172336 (and 0, 3, 4): the image is a check mark whose left arm (3 columns wide, 4 rows tall, 7 pixels) is clearly shorter and shallower than the right arm (7 columns, 8 rows, 19 pixels); the mark is visibly not mirror-symmetric about its vertex at column 6 (exact mirror test false). The tick form conveys successful completion.

requirements.name: ready-meaning
requirements.check: Viewed alone, the image reads as successful completion (Ready) rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
requirements.reason: Viewed alone (view 1 at 1x and view 2 at 3x on the panel colour), the single tick reads as done/success. It is not a spinner, dots or loop (activity), not an X or warning (failure), not paired bars (pause), and not the rightward play triangle of assets/start.svg (idle Start).

requirements.name: readability-1x-3x
requirements.check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail (including the asymmetry of the check-mark arms) lost into the panel colour.
requirements.reason: View 1 (16x16 on #172336) and view 2 (48x48 nearest on #172336) both show a readable check silhouette; the short-left/long-right asymmetry remains visible at 1x and is unmistakable at 3x. Nothing is lost into the panel colour (mark luma 169 vs panel luma 34).

requirements.name: cool-blue-accent
requirements.check: The dominant colour treatment visibly relates to the existing UI's cool blue accent as seen in assets/start.svg (#70b9ed). This is a visual relationship judgement, not an exact-hex or palette-count rule.
requirements.reason: The mark's only visible colour is sky blue rgba(112,185,237,255) = #70b9ed, the same cool blue as the assets/start.svg fill; viewed on the navy panel it reads as the existing UI accent. Judged as a visual relationship; the exact-hex equality is an observation, not the rule applied.

requirements.name: silhouette-without-color
requirements.check: In a grayscale/desaturated view at 1x and 3x, the Ready mark still has a distinct identifiable shape (its meaning is carried by form, not only hue).
requirements.reason: In the derived desaturated views (work/queue.ready/rev3/inspection/derived-desaturated-1x-on-172336.png 16x16 and derived-desaturated-3x-on-172336.png 48x48, luma composite on #172336) the mark remains a distinct, identifiable check shape at both 1x and 3x; its meaning is carried by form. Packet views 0-4 were all observed; the grayscale derivatives are supplementary derived evidence, not candidates.

requirements.name: sample-pixel-craft
requirements.check: As a representative family sample, the image shows deliberate pixel-art construction: clean pixel clusters and edges, no noisy stray pixels, blur or downscaled-illustration artifacts, and a treatment that could plausibly be extended to Working, Retry and Paused.
requirements.reason: Views 2 and 4 at 3x show deliberate construction: one flat colour, hard binary edges, consistent 1px-per-row diagonal stair clusters, pointed tips, one connected component, no stray pixels, blur, anti-aliasing or downscaled-illustration artifacts. The flat single-accent chunky-stroke treatment could plausibly be extended to Working, Retry and Paused; this does not approve the family style.

"""Caller helper (second save): restore queue.ready `existing` to its requirement-time bytes.

The runtime's requirements identity (_requirements) excludes only status/next/evidence/production,

and made the completed generation's selection read as 'changed'. Nothing the generation was reviewed
against changed. This save restores the prior `existing` entry exactly, records the delivered file
under `evidence` (excluded from the hash) and amends `next`. No other row or field changes.

Run from the consumer root:
  python -I work/queue.ready/caller/plar-update-delivery2.py work/queue.ready/caller/plar-update-delivery2.json
"""
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

out = Path(sys.argv[1])
doc = json.loads(Path("plar.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
prior = json.loads(Path(".pixl/plar-history/32e1590fc1220abe61d23f0193a739e52644bcab093c2bf98b13c368adab5e85.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
before = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
row = next(a for a in doc["assets"] if a["id"] == "queue.ready")
prior_row = next(a for a in prior["assets"] if a["id"] == "queue.ready")


def sha(rel):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


CAND = sha("assets/ready-confirmed.png")
assert CAND == "fc5e43ae9db53c12cdb419794b36ef09a8ae8cf2be996954ae7390396a268ac5"

row["existing"] = json.loads(json.dumps(prior_row["existing"]))
row["evidence"].append({
    "path": "assets/ready-confirmed.png",
    "note": (
        f"Delivered file at the PLAR destination: exact bytes of nominated candidate r.028f320bf7292612.candidate.ready "
        f"(sha256 {CAND}, 210 bytes, 16x16 RGBA, 1 frame), byte-identical to the retained PX2 artifact and to the "
        "controlled-create-0002 download (evaluator fixture from pixellab-test, provider_simulated=true). The `existing` "
        "entry above is deliberately left at its requirement-time text because the runtime includes `existing` in "
        "requirements_hash; the file's presence is reported by the reader, not by that prose."
    ),
})
row["next"] = (
    "Delivered: r.028f320bf7292612.task is done (store revision 17, hash fc545519...), candidate "
    "r.028f320bf7292612.candidate.ready passed all eight rev3 criteria (review r.028f320bf7292612.review1) and its "
    "exact bytes are at assets/ready-confirmed.png (see evidence); node verify-integration.mjs confirmed statusCell and "
    "compactStatus resolve succeeded -> Ready -> this path with frames 1 and a 16x16 PNG header. The image is an "
    "evaluator fixture from the controlled pixellab-test connection (controlled-create-0002), not upstream PixelLab art. "
    "Requirements are unchanged since the reviewed contract (requirements_hash 244f4591...); the `existing` entry keeps "
    "its requirement-time wording so that identity is preserved. Remaining: (1) record the Ready representative-sample "
    "style decision and source-bind the approved reference before expanding queue.working, queue.retry and "
    "queue.paused; (2) exercise statusCell/compactStatus in an actual renderer when one exists (none supplied; "
    "unverified); (3) run the family distinction reviews (Working not success; Retry and Paused distinguishable without "
    "colour) once those assets exist. Do not reuse controlled-create-0002 on a real PixelLab service; any further Ready "
    "generation needs a new, separately authorized request. Earlier tasks 'task' and r.f9e2fa53f4fcac2a.task remain "
    "open history with plar_selection blockers."
)

# Guards: only queue.ready existing/evidence/next changed; existing now equals the prior version exactly.
for a_old, a_new in zip(before["assets"], doc["assets"]):
    if a_old["id"] != "queue.ready":
        assert a_old == a_new, a_old["id"]
    else:
        for k in a_old:
            if k not in ("existing", "next", "evidence"):
                assert a_old[k] == a_new[k], k
for k in before:
    if k != "assets":
        assert before[k] == doc[k], k
assert row["existing"] == prior_row["existing"]
req_keys = [k for k in prior_row if k not in ("status", "next", "evidence", "production")]
assert all(prior_row[k] == row[k] for k in req_keys), "requirement-identity fields differ from the reviewed version"
out.write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(out, hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest())

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
requirements.reason: Measured: PNG IHDR 16x16, 8-bit RGBA, single frame (frame_count 1, n_frames 1), no horizontal strip or extra canvas (pixl_asset_check width/height 16 pass; pixel-dump size [16,16]).

requirements.name: transparent-background
requirements.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.
requirements.reason: Measured: alpha histogram {0: 227, 255: 29}; every pixel outside the single 29-pixel mark component has alpha 0; all four edge rows/columns fully transparent; no matte, box or fringe (fractional_alpha_pixels 0, opaque_components 1). Checkerboard views 3 and 4 confirm visually.

requirements.name: check-mark-asymmetrical-arms
requirements.check: The image visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms: the mark is not mirror-symmetric about its vertex. Asymmetry may come, for example, from clearly unequal arm lengths or from clearly different arm angles/directions; unequal length is one example, not the required condition. The mark conveys successful completion. Either arm may be the longer one, and stroke weight, colour treatment and construction are not restricted by this criterion.
requirements.reason: Viewed in views 1 and 2 on #172336 (and 0, 3, 4): the image is a check mark whose left arm (3 columns wide, 4 rows tall, 7 pixels) is clearly shorter and shallower than the right arm (7 columns, 8 rows, 19 pixels); the mark is visibly not mirror-symmetric about its vertex at column 6 (exact mirror test false). The tick form conveys successful completion.

requirements.name: ready-meaning
requirements.check: Viewed alone, the image reads as successful completion (Ready) rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
requirements.reason: Viewed alone (view 1 at 1x and view 2 at 3x on the panel colour), the single tick reads as done/success. It is not a spinner, dots or loop (activity), not an X or warning (failure), not paired bars (pause), and not the rightward play triangle of assets/start.svg (idle Start).

requirements.name: readability-1x-3x
requirements.check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail (including the asymmetry of the check-mark arms) lost into the panel colour.

requirements.name: cool-blue-accent

Judged as a visual relationship; the exact-hex equality is an observation, not the rule applied.
